body:
Good morning, Bakersfield. It’s Saturday, August 22, 2026, and we’re starting the day with a high of 100° and air quality at a moderate 58. Overnight, a shooting at a Taco Bell in east Bakersfield was the most serious incident, with one person reportedly shot and the suspect last seen in a white vehicle. Today’s top story is the arrest of a 15-year-old in connection to the deadly shooting at Independence High School’s football game last night. Let’s get you caught up on the night and what’s ahead.

## The Kern Overnight

The night’s most serious call came just after midnight when a witness reported seeing someone shot at a Taco Bell in the Baker Street area. Officers responded with an officer-safety broadcast after the witness described the suspect as a white male in his 40s to 50s, wearing a black shirt and dark pants, sitting inside a white vehicle — possibly a Ford Explorer. Before that, crews knocked down a fire at a vacant house on King Street around 2:16 a.m., where flames were visible inside the single-story structure with heavy smoke showing. Multiple engines and a truck company responded, and the fire was under control by about 2:25. Just before 11 p.m., a two-vehicle collision left one vehicle on fire near Gosford Road and Harris Road. Engine 14 and Engine 9 responded to the scene, where one car was smoking with another about a quarter mile back, and command dubbed it the Harris Incident; injuries were unknown. Multiple reports of a grass fire along southbound Highway 395 north of Brown Road drew a large response — engines, patrol units, a water tender, a dozer and a helicopter — but crews found a small roadside fire that was quickly extinguished, and the extra equipment was canceled. Around 10:38 p.m., an assault with a knife was reported with no injuries; the suspect — about 6 feet tall with neck tattoos, wearing black shorts, a gray shirt and white shoes — fled on foot northbound.

## Today's weather

Expect a high near 100° and a low around 74° tonight. It’s currently 97° at Meadows Field (KBFL). There are no active weather alerts for Kern County, and air quality is 58 — moderate.

## Top stories

**KGET 17 reports that Bakersfield Mayor Karen Goh has released a statement on the deadly shooting at Independence High School.** In her remarks, Mayor Goh expressed her deep concern and sadness over the tragic incident that occurred during a football game at the school. She emphasized that the safety of our students and community members is of utmost importance and that her thoughts are with the victims and their families during this difficult time.

**According to 23ABC, officials have announced the arrest of a 15-year-old suspect in connection to the deadly shooting at Independence High School’s football game.** The arrest was made Saturday morning in the 7500 block of Stockdale Highway. No other arrests have been announced, and no other suspects have been identified at this time. The investigation is ongoing.

**Bakersfield Now tells us that Southwest Market has canceled its Saturday event at Independence High School following the fatal shooting.** The market, which was scheduled to take place on the school’s campus, has been called off in light of the tragic incident that occurred during last night’s football game.

## Something good

A local family is hosting a Saturday flea market to raise funds for Villafana’s prosthetic leg. The event aims to collect $8,900 to support this important cause. It’s a heartwarming effort that shows the strength of our community in coming together to help one of our own.

## Coming up this week

This week, there are several events and meetings worth noting. On Tuesday, August 26, the Bakersfield City Council will hold a Special City Council Meeting at 12:00 p.m., followed by a City Council Meeting at 3:30 p.m. and another at 5:15 p.m. For entertainment, the Fox Theater has a full lineup: tonight, August 22, enjoy Los Yonic's Zamacona, Los caminantes, y Grupo Yndio. On Tuesday, August 24, catch the Cults & Classics: Season Pass 2026-2027. Later in the week, Rodney Carrington takes the stage on Thursday, August 27, followed by CUMBIATRON: THE CUMBIA RAVE on Friday, August 28. On Saturday, August 29, you can choose between Willie Barcena and Michael Return Of The King Tribute Featuring Michael Phoenix, both performing at the Fox Theater.
